events.did: took the red pickup truck off down the packed dirt road
events.quote_anchor: THE red pickup truck took off down the packed dirt road.

events.did: shed his camouflage, the tree line melting away and turning back to cloth and skin
events.quote_anchor: The way the tree line shimmered, warped, before a human-sized section melted away from branch and trunk, turning back to cloth and skin as the EO shed his camouflage.

events.did: rolled his eyes and asked to be patched through to Dr. Gray
events.quote_anchor: He rolled his eyes. “Patch me through to Dr. Gray.”

events.did: told Dr. Gray he had found the girl, described the cabin and the town, and added that she was not alone
events.quote_anchor: “I found the girl.” He gave a description of the cabin, the town, before adding, “She’s not alone.”

events.did: told Dr. Gray they were on the move but that he had eyes on them
events.quote_anchor: “Negative,” he said, squinting down the empty road. “They’re on the move. But I have eyes.”

events.did: watched the distance between the two dots on his phone steadily increase, glad he had put the tracker on the truck while they were packing
events.quote_anchor: On his phone, two dots flashed on the screen, his and theirs. He watched the distance between them steadily increasing, glad he’d put the tracker on the truck

events.did: gave Noah the order to go after them
events.quote_anchor: In his ear, Gabriel gave the order. “Go after them.”

events.did: cracked his neck and started down the road
events.quote_anchor: “Understood.” Noah cracked his neck and started down the road.

relations.did: told Noah well done and asked whether they were still there
relations.quote_anchor: “Well done,” said Dr. Gray. “Are they still there?”

relations.did: guessed the girl Noah had found might be Vale, and was told it was Mitchell Turner and the dog
relations.quote_anchor: He could hear the pencil tapping lightly on the desk. Then stop. “Vale?”

relations.did: spoke in Noah’s ear, calling him Haley, like the comet
relations.quote_anchor: “Haley. Like the comet,” drawled Weaver in his ear, somehow still sarcastic.

numbers.did: had blended seamlessly into the woods in one moment
numbers.quote_anchor: One moment, he’d blended seamlessly into the woods.

numbers.did: watched two dots flash on his phone screen, his and theirs
numbers.quote_anchor: On his phone, two dots flashed on the screen, his and theirs.

numbers.did: kept one hand in his pocket and his sunglasses on the bridge of his nose
numbers.quote_anchor: Blond hair cropped close, the way he’d kept it since his military days, one hand in his pocket and the sunglasses perched on the bridge of his nose.

numbers.did: was empty, no one there to see what happened next
numbers.quote_anchor: No one was there to see what happened next.
